001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
004
005import java.util.List;
006
007/**
008 * <p>
009 * The Clafer model. Also acts as the implicit "root" Clafer which nests above
010 * the top most Clafers.
011 * </p>
012 * <p>
013 * For example:
014 * <pre>
015 * abstract Feature
016 *     Cost -> integer
017 * Database : Feature
018 * </pre> Although the model is written syntactically like above, its
019 * representation internally is more like:
020 * <pre>
021 * #root#
022 *     abstract Feature
023 *         Cost -> integer
024 *     Database : Feature
025 * </pre> {@code #root#} is represented by this class.
026 * </p>
027 *
028 * @author jimmy
029 */
030public class AstModel {
031
032    private final AstAbstractClafer abstractRootClafer;
033    private final AstConcreteClafer rootClafer;
034    // the type every non-primitive non-root type extends from.
035    private final AstAbstractClafer typeRoot;
036
037    AstModel() {
038        this.abstractRootClafer = new AstAbstractClafer("#root#", null) {
039
040            @Override
041            protected AstAbstractClafer getClaferClafer() {
042                return typeRoot;
043            }
044        };
045        this.rootClafer = new AstConcreteClafer("root", null).extending(abstractRootClafer).withCard(1, 1);
046        this.typeRoot = abstractRootClafer.addAbstractChild("#clafer#");
047    }
048
049    public AstAbstractClafer getAbstractRoot() {
050        return abstractRootClafer;
051    }
052
053    public AstConcreteClafer getRoot() {
054        return rootClafer;
055    }
056
057    public AstAbstractClafer getTypeRoot() {
058        return typeRoot;
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * Returns all the abstract Clafers
063     *
064     * @return all the abstract Clafers
065     */
066    public List<AstAbstractClafer> getAbstracts() {
067        return abstractRootClafer.getAbstractChildren();
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Add a new abstract Clafer to the model. .
072     *
073     * @param name the name of the abtract Clafer
074     * @return the new abstract Clafer
075     */
076    public AstAbstractClafer addAbstract(String name) {
077        return abstractRootClafer.addAbstractChild(name);
078    }
079
080    public List<AstConcreteClafer> getChildren() {
081        return abstractRootClafer.getChildren();
082    }
083
084    public AstConcreteClafer addChild(String name) {
085        return abstractRootClafer.addChild(name);
086    }
087
088    public boolean hasConstraints() {
089        return abstractRootClafer.hasConstraints();
090    }
091
092    public List<AstConstraint> getConstraints() {
093        return abstractRootClafer.getConstraints();
094    }
095
096    public AstConstraint addConstraint(AstBoolExpr expr) {
097        return abstractRootClafer.addConstraint(expr);
098    }
099
100    public AstConstraint addConstraint(AstBoolExpr expr, SourceSpan span) {
101        return abstractRootClafer.addConstraint(expr, span);
102    }
103}
